user_stories.title: Basic Contact Form Submission
user_stories.story: As a website visitor, I want to submit a contact form with my details, so that I can reach the website owner
acceptance_criteria: Accept name, email, subject, message fields
Message must be at least 10 characters
Return 201 on success, 400 on validation error

user_stories.title: Email Notification
user_stories.story: As a website owner, I want to receive an email when someone submits the contact form
